parameters.formDescription: Apply for open positions at Virim Infotech Pvt. Ltd.

attributes.name: currentJobTitle
attributes.description: Current or most recent job title or role mentioned in the resume. Return the exact title.

attributes.name: highestDegree
attributes.description: Highest degree or education level mentioned in the resume, including institution name

attributes.name: totalExperienceYears
attributes.description: Total years of professional experience. For freshers or students, return 0.

attributes.name: frontendSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of frontend frameworks, libraries, and tools: React, Angular, Vue, Next.js, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, Bootstrap, JavaScript, TypeScript, jQuery, etc.

attributes.name: frontendLevel
attributes.description: Frontend proficiency level: one of 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: backendSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of backend languages, frameworks, and tools: Node.js, Express, Django, Flask, Spring, PHP, Laravel, NestJS, REST API, GraphQL, etc.

attributes.name: backendLevel
attributes.description: Backend proficiency level: one of 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: databaseSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of databases and data storage tools: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Firebase, Oracle, SQL Server, etc.

attributes.name: databaseLevel
attributes.description: Database proficiency level: one of 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: aiMlSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of AI, ML, or automation skills: TensorFlow, PyTorch, OpenAI, LangChain, ChatGPT, ML, NLP, Computer Vision, etc. Return 'None' if nothing found.

attributes.name: aiMlLevel
attributes.description: AI/ML proficiency level: one of 'expert', 'advanced', 'intermediate', 'beginner', or 'none'

attributes.name: cloudDevOps
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cloud and DevOps skills: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Jenkins, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Heroku, Vercel, etc. Return 'None' if nothing found.

attributes.name: programmingLanguages
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of programming languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, C++, C#, Go, Rust, PHP, Ruby, etc.

attributes.name: certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of certifications mentioned. Return 'None' if nothing found.

attributes.name: notableProjects
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of notable projects (max 3), each as a brief one-line summary. Use | as separator. Example: Built e-commerce app with React | Created REST API with Node.js

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: Extract the city (and optionally state/country, but primarily the city name, e.g. 'Mumbai', 'San Francisco') where the candidate is located as mentioned in the resume. Return a single city name if possible. If not found, return 'N/A' or 'Unknown'.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an expert technical recruiter and resume parser. Extract ALL technical details with high accuracy from the resume. Be thorough — do not miss any technology, tool, framework, or language mentioned. For skill levels, judge based on context: projects, experience duration, and depth of usage. For freshers with academic projects, use 'beginner' or 'intermediate' levels, not 'none'.

values.name: jd_text
values.stringValue: Job Title: Fresher Full Stack Developer  We are looking for a motivated Fresher Full Stack Developer to join our team and grow with hands-on project experience. The role is ideal for candidates who have a strong foundation in web development and a basic understanding of AI concepts or tools.  Responsibilities: - Assist in developing and maintaining web applications - Work on frontend features using React or similar frameworks - Support backend development using Node.js, Express, or similar technologies - Help build and test REST APIs - Work with databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL - Fix bugs, improve UI, and support performance optimization - Collaborate with team members to deliver features on time - Learn and apply basic AI-assisted tools or integrations when needed  Required Skills: - Good knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic TypeScript - Familiarity with React and Node.js - Basic understanding of backend APIs and databases - Knowledge of Git and version control - Problem-solving attitude and willingness to learn - Strong communication and teamwork skills  Preferred Skills: - Exposure to cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP - Basic understanding of AI tools, LLMs, or prompt engineering - Academic or personal projects in full stack development - Interest in learning modern development practices  Education / Experience: - Fresher or up to 1 year of experience - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field preferred - Internship or project experience will be an advantage  We are looking for someone eager to learn, adaptable, and comfortable working across both frontend and backend tasks. A little knowledge of AI is enough; strong fundamentals and enthusiasm matter most.

parameters.jsCode:
const d = $input.item.json;

const prompt = `You are a fair technical recruiter evaluating candidates for a fresher/junior role. Score generously for entry-level applicants.

IMPORTANT SCORING RULES:
1. Score each category on its OWN scale (not 0-100). The scales are shown below.
2. Give PARTIAL CREDIT generously. If a candidate mentions ANY relevant skill, give at least 40-50% of the category max.
3. Academic projects, internships, and coursework ALL count as valid experience.
4. For freshers with basic skills, a total score of 50-70 is normal and expected.
5. Only give very low scores (below 30% of max) if the candidate has ZERO relevant skills in that category.

Scoring breakdown — each category has its own max:
- frontendScore:  0 to 25 points (HTML/CSS/JS basics = 10-12, React/Vue knowledge = 15-20, expert with projects = 20-25)
- backendScore:   0 to 25 points (knows any backend language = 8-12, Node/Express/Django = 13-18, production experience = 19-25)
- databaseScore:  0 to 20 points (knows SQL basics = 6-10, used MySQL/MongoDB in projects = 10-14, production DB work = 15-20)
- aiMlScore:      0 to 15 points (heard of AI/used ChatGPT = 3-5, used AI APIs/tools = 6-10, built AI features = 11-15)
- experienceScore: 0 to 10 points (fresher with projects = 4-6, internship = 5-7, 1+ year work = 7-10)
- softSkillsScore: 0 to 5 points  (applied properly = 2-3, good communication evident = 3-4, leadership shown = 4-5)

totalScore = sum of all six scores above (max 100)

=== JOB DESCRIPTION ===
${d.jd_text}

=== CANDIDATE: ${d.candidateName || 'Unknown'} ===
Position Applied: ${d.position || 'Not specified'}
Experience: ${d.totalExperienceYears || d.yearsOfExp || 0} years
Current Role: ${d.currentJobTitle || 'Fresher / Student'}
Degree: ${d.highestDegree || 'Not mentioned'}

Frontend Skills: ${d.frontendSkills || 'Not mentioned'} (Level: ${d.frontendLevel || 'unknown'})
Backend Skills: ${d.backendSkills || 'Not mentioned'} (Level: ${d.backendLevel || 'unknown'})
Database Skills: ${d.databaseSkills || 'Not mentioned'} (Level: ${d.databaseLevel || 'unknown'})
AI/ML Skills: ${d.aiMlSkills || 'Not mentioned'} (Level: ${d.aiMlLevel || 'unknown'})
Cloud/DevOps: ${d.cloudDevOps || 'Not mentioned'}
Languages: ${d.programmingLanguages || 'Not mentioned'}
Certifications: ${d.certifications || 'None'}
Projects: ${d.notableProjects || 'None mentioned'}

Resume text (first 3000 chars):
${(d.resumeText || '').substring(0, 3000)}

=== RESPOND WITH ONLY THIS JSON (no markdown, no backticks, no explanation) ===
{
  "frontendScore": <0-25>,
  "backendScore": <0-25>,
  "databaseScore": <0-20>,
  "aiMlScore": <0-15>,
  "experienceScore": <0-10>,
  "softSkillsScore": <0-5>,
  "totalScore": <sum of above, 0-100>,
  "grade": "<A+|A|B+|B|C|D|F>",
  "recommendation": "<Strong Hire|Hire|Consider|Reject>",
  "summary": "<2-3 sentence candidate overview>",
  "strengths": ["strength 1","strength 2","strength 3"],
  "weaknesses": ["weakness 1","weakness 2"],
  "frontendFeedback": "<one sentence>",
  "backendFeedback": "<one sentence>",
  "databaseFeedback": "<one sentence>",
  "aiMlFeedback": "<one sentence>",
  "hiringNote": "<one key note for recruiter>"
}`;

return { json: { ...d, aiPrompt: prompt } };
